clock_fraction_30: Malay toward-the-hour half: "setengah <H>" == the half *before* hour H,
three), NOT 03:30. This is the German-style toward-hour reading, corroborated
across Malay usage. Kamus Dewan (DBP) gives "setengah jam" == 30 minutes (half
an hour); the toward-hour clock reading ("setengah tiga" == 02:30) is
corroborated across Malay usage sources -- a DBP-canonical clock-reading
passage was not obtained, stated honestly. The quarter (suku/seperempat) is
deliberately omitted: its direction is UNCONFIRMED (documented follow-up), so
only the unambiguous half is added.
clock_meridiem_night: The NIGHT daypart is a midnight-crossing BAND in colloquial clock usage,
not a uniform +12 PM shift: "pukul satu malam" (one at night) is 01:00,
"pukul sebelas malam" (eleven at night) is 23:00, twelve is midnight
00:00.  Small hours 1..5 stay AM, evening hours 6..11 are PM, twelve is
midnight (band-split in resolver _clock_hms).  Evening "malam" opens at
dayparts.py); the small hours read as "malam" colloquially.  Source:

Pustaka).  Listing the classifier form as a surface is what keeps "setiap
